description: Reviewed Captain list (compiler input, scripts/compile-league-catalog.mjs): real national-team captains, current players only, ranked leaders first. The compiler tags the first `size` players as Captain (catalog `captain: true`) and fails when an id, source name or nation does not match the catalog. `sofifaId` is the player_id of the source data (profileId ea:<id>:fc26:…). `size` is cut so that about one drafted World Cup XI in three has a captain (tools/calibration/draft-baselines.mjs --captains).
